content:
diego: Quick Q: I'm taking a 4-month remote stint in Mexico (2026-11-01 to 2027-02-28). Is that considered temporary or do I need to change tax/home_base stuff? Also, will WFH stipend continue and what about benefits?

nora-peopleops: 4 months is temporary (<6 months). Policy: stipend continues automatically up to 6 months. No home_base change required. Please submit the Temporary Work Abroad form and upload passport + dates.

sam-payroll: With 4 months you should remain on US payroll. No 401(k) change. We'll still run a short residency check but low risk of local payroll.

jill-benefits: Health coverage generally continues for <6 months. If you plan to see local docs, check out our travel medical add-on. We'll confirm with Benefits Ops after form.

olga-peopleops: Note: Mexico has local rules for telecommuting; ensure you keep records of days in-country. Also check visa/immigration rules.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: submit Temporary Work Abroad form at least 14 days before travel. Docs: https://docs.company/temporary-work-abroad

anna-manager: Approved for coworking expenses up to $100/month for the 4-month period. Diego: submit receipts to Concur monthly.

diego: Thanks all! I'll submit the form this afternoon and upload passport.
